verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a customer-service AI platform, but the evidence never documents bulk actions such as bulk-updating, closing, tagging or assigning many conversations or tickets at once. The related items do not qualify: exporting a saved View is a different feature, SDK pagination iterators are a developer building block, and testing across thousands of scenarios belongs to the simulation-testing story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
